release: Alin v4.2.0 Stable — Storefront Four Issues Fixed

desktop_options.root_cause: component CSS was dropped when storefront responsive CSS was rewritten
desktop_options.solution: desktop options component now lives in styles/alin-desktop.css with matching desktop-options-icon selector

subcategory_shelves.root_cause: fixed five-column rail made two products occupy two narrow fifths of the shelf
subcategory_shelves.solution: restored isolated auto-fit 190–220px desktop shelf and horizontal mobile shelf

mobile_category_words.root_cause: overflow-wrap:anywhere allowed Arabic category names to split inside a word
mobile_category_words.solution: word-break normal + overflow-wrap normal + no hyphenation in the source category component

single_mobile_splash.root_cause: touch entry could paint legacy index splash before store-mobile splash; installed PWA can also have an OS launch screen before the HTML splash
single_mobile_splash.solution: touch devices route from index head before body paint; standalone PWA suppresses the second HTML splash
